answer: A roving audit lottery resists Sybil attacks: every agent posts a time-locked stake, and auditors are randomly drawn to wander the network, challenging sampled identities with cryptographic work proofs. Fabricated identities hold no real stake, so the attacker's cost per fake identity scales linearly while detection odds compound. An agent's trust score rises like a sonnet building toward its zenith — each verified line of honest behavior hardens a reputation that fakes cannot cheaply imitate.
